rerolls.vs: unstable structure, active traps, trigger plates, load-bearing failure, Spark or chronoflux residue

triggers.offerText: Temporal Flinch — shift the one who was hit 1 square. GM: if that breaks the attack's range or line, the attack misses (refund the damage).

description.value:
"The lions are gone. The wolves are gone. The kings are gone. We're still here. Think about what that means."

Temporal Flinch (1/Soma Break). You experience the next two seconds as a faint pre-echo: you are immune to the Surprised condition while conscious. Reaction — when you or an ally within 2 squares is hit by an attack you can see, shift yourself or that ally 1 square; if that takes the target out of the attack's range or line, the attack misses (the GM refunds the damage).

Niche Survivor. You need roughly half the food, water, and air a comparable Medium creature needs. You reroll the lowest die on Body checks against suffocation, starvation, dehydration, and extreme temperature.

Vault Sight. You have darkvision out to 12 squares. You reroll the lowest die on Perception checks to notice unstable structure, active traps, trigger plates, load-bearing failures, and Spark or chronoflux residue.

Rat Inheritance. You can squeeze through gaps at least a foot wide without halving your movement, and you can hold a stillness that shouldn't work.
